description: Hard negatives mined from raw normalized metrics space (32-dim) instead of model embeddings. Mining from metrics bypasses the v4 feedback loop of bad negatives.
rationale: v4 mined hard negatives from model embeddings which start bad. Bad negatives -> bad signal -> no lift. Raw metrics carry 84% lift signal, so mining from metrics space produces meaningful negatives from epoch 1.

v4_compared.v4_issue: Mining from model embeddings creates a feedback loop: embeddings start bad -> mine wrong negatives -> optimize away wrong signal

expected_improvement: Should achieve lift above 40% (v3 best was 42.1%) by mining negatives from raw metrics space which already encodes the family structure signal.
